decisions.thought:
Lead: 44% BRING: garchomp, 29% BRING: ninetalesalola, 18% BRING: rotomwash
Pick 2: 73% BRING: rotomwash, 11% BRING: ninetalesalola, 7% BRING: gholdengo
Pick 3: 83% BRING: gholdengo, 9% BRING: scizor, 5% BRING: ninetalesalola

Incineroar lead gives Intimidate plus Taunt/Fake Out to stop Ninetales-Alola veil, a bad matchup to give away. Primarina covers Garchomp, opposing Incineroar, and Rotom-Wash. Kingambit gives a likely knockout on Gholdengo and Ninetales with Dark/Steel STAB.

decisions.thought: 99% MOVE: earthquake, 1% SWITCH: rotomwash, 0% MOVE: stoneedge
Garchomp outspeeds Incineroar, so priority is the deciding factor. Fake Out moves first and flinches, stopping a turn 1 attack or setup for free.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Adopting Muse Spark persona to select a single legal Pokémon action using speed, knockout, or matchup as the deciding factor without damage formulas.Selecting fakeout as the only legal priority move under the persona constraint.Evaluating priority, flinch chance, and pivot timing against a faster lead.

decisions.thought: 94% MOVE: earthquake, 5% SWITCH: rotomwash, 1% SWITCH: gholdengo
Incineroar is slower than Garchomp and in a bad matchup due to its Ground weakness. Parting Shot lets it pivot out while dropping Garchomp to -2 offenses to cripple it.

decisions.thought: Parting Shot forces a switch, and Garchomp moves first. Kingambit is weak to Earthquake, a bad matchup, while Primarina is immune to Dragon and threatens a knockout with Moonblast.

decisions.thought: 92% SWITCH: rotomwash, 5% SWITCH: gholdengo, 1% MOVE: earthquake

Garchomp is faster and at 78% with -2 Attack, but Primarina resists Dragon and should survive an Earthquake. Moonblast is super effective and gives the best chance to knock it out before it moves again.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Evaluating Pokémon type matchups and damage calculations to choose the optimal move.Comparing opponent switch options against Fairy and Water coverage.

decisions.thought: 96% MOVE: voltswitch, 3% SWITCH: gholdengo, 1% SWITCH: garchomp

Rotom is at 49% after taking ~57% from Moonblast last turn, so a second Moonblast is a likely knockout. Rotom moves first on speed, but full HP Primarina should survive one hit. Both bench switches are a bad matchup into Wash.

Primarina is slower than Gholdengo and faces a likely knockout from a super-effective Steel attack. This is a bad matchup to stay in. Kingambit resists both Steel and Ghost STAB.

Gholdengo outspeeds Kingambit but Make It Rain is resisted and Focus Sash is intact, so Kingambit should survive and KO back. Sucker Punch risks failing on a switch, while Kowtow Cleave never misses and is super effective.

decisions.thought: 100% SWITCH: rotomwash
61% MOVE: hydropump, 23% MOVE: voltswitch, 13% MOVE: willowisp

Kingambit at 5 HP dies to any hit and is slower than Rotom, so staying wastes it. Rotom is the last foe, so preserve Kingambit for a later Sucker Punch. Primarina is weak to Electric, Incineroar takes Volt Switch better.

Kingambit is slower than Rotom-Wash and will faint to any hit at 5 HP, but Sucker Punch has priority. Rotom is the last opponent, so free priority damage before fainting is best.
